title: AiAltText
description:
Payload of `ai.alt_text` jobs, schema `ai.alt_text@1`. Runs in the engine: fetches the image
through egress, drafts alt text with `packages/ai` within the store's budget, and proposes a
data fix for the merchant to approve. Nothing is written to Shopify here.

finding_id.description: The `findings.id` of the missing or poor alt text.

input_id.description: The `scan_inputs.id` holding the image's context (product title, existing alt text).

resource_gid.description: The Shopify GID of the media image, such as `gid://shopify/MediaImage/1`.
